title: Pre-Sampling Feasibility Amendment
trigger: Exact-slot joint-feasibility audit of the frozen P0.2.3 pool before any Gold100 sampling.

feasibility_findings.finding: P0.2.3 stress pre-reservations satisfied marginal stratum counts but not all slot-level domain targets.
feasibility_findings.impact: P0.2.4 must assign final stress slots from frozen source-grounded tags rather than reuse provisional stress_stratum reservations as final slot ownership.

feasibility_findings.finding: Frozen pool had only one external companion/secondary StudyIdentity-dependent candidate, but exact slots require one external core companion plus one external StudyIdentity stress source without SourceArtifact reuse.
feasibility_findings.impact: Joint slot assignment infeasible without a pre-sampling source-universe amendment.

feasibility_findings.finding: Final Gold100 requires incomplete_source_text >=5 while only two incomplete-specific slots exist. With frozen tags, at most four incomplete sources could legally occupy stress slots.
feasibility_findings.impact: A source-grounded missed normative-boundary tag must be corrected or the frozen design would remain infeasible.

feasibility_findings.finding: StudyIdentity_dependency >=15 was jointly infeasible under source-family/slot constraints despite marginal pool count=20.
feasibility_findings.impact: At least one non-companion family source with an explicit companion relationship is required.

source_additions.title: Evidence based community mobilization for dengue prevention in Nicaragua and Mexico (Camino Verde, the Green Way): cluster randomized controlled trial.
source_additions.reason: Provides a non-companion StudyIdentity-dependent source eligible for a core interventional slot.

source_additions.title: Influence of induction chemotherapy in trimodality therapy-eligible oesophageal cancer patients: secondary analysis of a randomised trial.
source_additions.reason: External companion/secondary source from an independent StudyIdentity cluster.

source_additions.title: CT Perfusion Imaging After Selection for Late-Window Endovascular Stroke Treatment: Secondary Analysis of the MR CLEAN-LATE Randomized Trial.
source_additions.reason: Second independent external companion/StudyIdentity source required for simultaneous core + stress slot feasibility.

tag_amendments.evidence_basis: Consensus statement limits supplementation/intervention justification to scientifically defined risk groups; this is a material normative population boundary.

prohibited_changes: No change to Stress20 slot counts.
No AB/model output may influence amendment or selection.
